description: Header file defining internal structures, classes, enums, and function prototypes for bot behavior and navigation in the Unvanquished game source code.

classes.name: botTarget_t
classes.description: Represents a bot's target, which can be an entity or a coordinate, with methods to access and validate the target.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assigns a gentity_t pointer or glm::vec3 position to the botTarget_t instance.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the target to an empty state.

methods.name: getTargetType
methods.description: Returns the type of target (EMPTY, COORDS, ENTITY).

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the target is valid.

methods.name: targetsCoordinates
methods.description: Checks if the target is a coordinate.

methods.name: targetsValidEntity
methods.description: Checks if the target is a valid, alive entity.

methods.name: getPos
methods.description: Returns the position of the target.
